falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any daily close in next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically saw immediate stabilization without retest to new lows; a break below 4950 would violate the structural support level established in that analog and invalidate the bottoming thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The referenced bottom pattern featured VIX peaking and rapidly compressing; sustained elevated fear above 35 indicates capitulation is ongoing rather than completed, contradicting the 76% pattern match to a concluded bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts (10Y yield > 2Y yield by >10bps) and holds for 3+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug occurred with curve deeply inverted; a sustained uninversion signals recession realization rather than soft-landing bottoming, breaking the macro conditions that enabled that pattern's recovery

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
